introHtml: Construction sites demand durable, reusable hot cold packs that can handle tough conditions. Our custom construction hot cold packs feature rugged nylon or gel bead construction, perfect for treating muscle strains and minor injuries on the job. With imprint options for your company logo, these packs double as safety giveaways that promote your brand while providing essential relief. Ideal for safety managers equipping first aid kits or marketing directors distributing at trade shows.
